authorship: Coding-assistant-authored; not independent natural demand evidence

domains.title: Review uncertain invoice fields
domains.task: Route uncertain invoice OCR fields to a person with links to the original image regions.
domains.taskZh: 将发票识别中不确定的字段交给人工审核，并链接到原始图片区域。
domains.paraphrase: Let a clerk inspect doubtful characters on supplier bills beside the source pixels.
domains.otherTask: Forecast next month cash balance from paid invoices.
domains.nearbyTask: Archive original invoice images for retention without reviewing OCR uncertainty.

domains.title: Resolve appointment request conflicts
domains.task: Compare appointment requests with room availability and prepare scheduling conflicts for a receptionist.
domains.taskZh: 对照诊室空闲情况检查预约请求，把时间冲突交给前台处理。
domains.paraphrase: Flag booking clashes against free consultation spaces so the front desk can choose a slot.
domains.otherTask: Summarize anonymous patient satisfaction questionnaires.
domains.nearbyTask: Send reminders for already confirmed appointments without checking room conflicts.

domains.title: Track missing trip consent
domains.task: Identify missing parental consent fields in school trip forms and prepare a correction list.
domains.taskZh: 识别学校出行表格中缺失的家长同意字段，并准备补充清单。
domains.paraphrase: Give excursion staff a checklist of incomplete guardian permission paperwork.
domains.otherTask: Allocate bus seats to classes using confirmed passenger counts.
domains.nearbyTask: Store completed consent forms for audit without checking which fields are missing.

domains.title: Combine repeated repair reports
domains.task: Group tenant repair reports about the same unit and fault while preserving separate reporter evidence.
domains.taskZh: 按相同房屋单元和故障归并住户报修，同时保留各报告人的独立证据。
domains.paraphrase: Unite duplicate resident fault notices for one apartment without discarding who reported each issue.
domains.otherTask: Calculate monthly building utility consumption from meter readings.
domains.nearbyTask: Rank different repair jobs by urgency without deciding whether reports describe one fault.

domains.title: Reconcile shipment charge documents
domains.task: Match shipment identifiers across carrier invoices and delivery receipts and flag unmatched charges.
domains.taskZh: 核对承运商发票与交付回执中的货运编号，并标记无法匹配的费用。
domains.paraphrase: Find billed loads lacking a corresponding proof of delivery by reconciling consignment references.
domains.otherTask: Estimate next quarter freight volume from historical bookings.
domains.nearbyTask: Convert carrier invoice currencies without linking charges to delivery evidence.

domains.personaZh: 非营利机构项目协调员
domains.title: Check grant evidence completeness
domains.task: Check whether each grant reporting requirement has a supplied evidence file and list missing items.
domains.taskZh: 检查每项资助报告要求是否有相应证据文件，并列出缺失材料。
domains.paraphrase: Map funder deliverables to uploaded attachments and surface documentation gaps.
domains.otherTask: Schedule volunteer shifts from their stated availability.
domains.nearbyTask: Summarize the supplied grant report without checking requirements against attachments.

domains.title: Route ambiguous support tickets
domains.task: Route ambiguous product support tickets to a human specialist with the relevant quoted symptoms.
domains.taskZh: 将含糊的产品支持工单交给人工专家，并提供相关症状原文。
domains.paraphrase: Escalate unclear help requests to the right colleague alongside verbatim problem descriptions.
domains.otherTask: Forecast weekly staffing demand from historical ticket volumes.
domains.nearbyTask: Automatically close old support tickets based on age without reviewing their symptoms.

domains.title: Find missing claim attachments
domains.task: Check submitted insurance document packets for missing listed attachments without deciding coverage.
domains.taskZh: 按清单检查提交的保险材料包是否缺少附件，但不判断保障范围。
domains.paraphrase: Tell intake staff which required files were absent from a claimant bundle, leaving entitlement decisions alone.
domains.otherTask: Aggregate anonymized call center wait times by weekday.
domains.nearbyTask: Determine whether an insurance claim is covered instead of checking attachment completeness.

domains.title: Compare vendor document revisions
domains.task: Compare two vendor specification revisions and show changed requirements with exact source locations.
domains.taskZh: 比较供应商规格文件的两个修订版本，并显示要求变化及准确出处。
domains.paraphrase: Highlight altered supplier terms between document editions with pointers to the affected passages.
domains.otherTask: Forecast annual purchases by department from approved orders.
domains.nearbyTask: Rank vendors by quoted price without analyzing changes between specification versions.

domains.title: Review duplicate receipt submissions
domains.task: Flag possible duplicate expense receipts using transaction details and show both original receipts for review.
domains.taskZh: 依据交易信息标记可能重复的费用收据，并展示两份原件供审核。
domains.paraphrase: Find reimbursement slips that may describe one purchase and let an auditor compare the originals.
domains.otherTask: Estimate future travel budgets from planned headcount.
domains.nearbyTask: Extract totals from each expense receipt independently without checking repeated purchases.

domains.title: Reconcile catalog variant identifiers
domains.task: Match supplier product variants to store catalog identifiers and flag ambiguous mappings for a person.
domains.taskZh: 将供应商产品变体匹配到门店目录编号，并把有歧义的映射交给人工。
domains.paraphrase: Help staff align vendor item options with internal SKUs where the correspondence is unclear.
domains.otherTask: Design weekly promotional banners for already mapped products.
domains.nearbyTask: Count stock for known catalog identifiers without resolving supplier variant mappings.

domains.title: Check incomplete service records
domains.task: Identify incomplete equipment service records and list the missing inspection fields without operating equipment.
domains.taskZh: 识别不完整的设备维护记录并列出缺失检查字段，不操作设备。
domains.paraphrase: Give planners a gap list for unfinished machine upkeep paperwork while leaving controls untouched.
domains.otherTask: Allocate technicians to shifts from approved leave calendars.
domains.nearbyTask: Remotely operate equipment based on service records instead of checking documentation gaps.

domains.title: Check citation support
domains.task: Match report claims to supplied paper excerpts and flag claims lacking supporting quotations.
domains.taskZh: 将报告论断与提供的论文片段匹配，并标记缺少支持引文的论断。
domains.paraphrase: Show which assertions in a draft have no backing passage in the attached literature.
domains.otherTask: Schedule conference presentations according to speaker availability.
domains.nearbyTask: Format the bibliography without checking whether the cited papers support report claims.

domains.title: Reconcile received package counts
domains.task: Compare receiving logs with packing lists and flag package-count discrepancies with linked records.
domains.taskZh: 对照收货记录与装箱单，标记包裹数量差异并链接相关记录。
domains.paraphrase: Find mismatches between delivered carton tallies and dispatch paperwork for dock staff.
domains.otherTask: Forecast warehouse electricity use from historical meter data.
domains.nearbyTask: Assign shelf locations to received packages without comparing received and listed counts.

domains.title: Check sample metadata completeness
domains.task: Check sample metadata tables for missing collection fields and inconsistent identifiers without interpreting test results.
domains.taskZh: 检查样本元数据表中缺失的采集字段和不一致编号，不解读检测结果。
domains.paraphrase: Surface gaps and mismatched labels in specimen intake spreadsheets while leaving assay interpretation to specialists.
domains.otherTask: Schedule shared meeting rooms from staff availability.
domains.nearbyTask: Interpret assay results instead of validating sample collection metadata.

domains.title: Group repeated test failures
domains.task: Group repeated test failures by the same error signature while retaining links to every failing run.
domains.taskZh: 按相同错误特征归并重复测试失败，同时保留每次失败运行的链接。
domains.paraphrase: Consolidate recurring CI breakages with identical fault fingerprints without losing individual execution evidence.
domains.otherTask: Estimate next sprint feature effort from backlog descriptions.
domains.nearbyTask: Hide flaky test failures from the release dashboard without determining their shared cause.

domains.title: Review uncertain label transcription
domains.task: Flag uncertain transcribed collection-label text and link each passage to the source image for curator review.
domains.taskZh: 标记藏品标签转录中的不确定文字，并链接原始图像供策展人员核对。
domains.paraphrase: Let catalog staff inspect doubtful lettering on object tags next to the photographed pixels.
domains.otherTask: Allocate exhibition room bookings from event schedules.
domains.nearbyTask: Translate already verified catalog descriptions without reviewing label transcription uncertainty.

domains.personaZh: 建筑公用事业分析人员
domains.title: Validate interval meter data
domains.task: Identify missing or repeated meter intervals before deterministic usage calculations and retain the raw reading references.
domains.taskZh: 在确定性用量计算前识别缺失或重复的电表时间间隔，并保留原始读数引用。
domains.paraphrase: Check time-series consumption feeds for gaps and double entries before totaling them, keeping links to the source rows.
domains.otherTask: Draft meeting agendas from maintenance staff notes.
domains.nearbyTask: Recommend a tariff from incomplete interval data without first checking gaps and duplicates.

domains.title: Match application response messages
domains.task: Match supplied recruitment response messages to the correct role application and leave ambiguous links for review.
domains.taskZh: 将提供的招聘回复消息匹配到对应岗位申请，并保留有歧义的关联供审核。
domains.paraphrase: Associate hiring replies with the right candidacy record, asking a person when several vacancies fit.
domains.otherTask: Summarize anonymized recruiter workload by week.
domains.nearbyTask: Send new applications automatically rather than associating already received response evidence.

domains.title: Compare drawing revision references
domains.task: Compare document registers with drawing revision labels and flag outdated references for a coordinator.
domains.taskZh: 对照文件登记表与图纸修订标记，向协调员提示过期引用。
domains.paraphrase: Find register entries that point to superseded plan editions by checking their version marks.
domains.otherTask: Allocate meeting times for subcontractor coordination.
domains.nearbyTask: Approve structural design decisions instead of checking drawing version references.
